text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service `redwood-inference-prod` (sev2) — pgd.it/INC-45892. Trigger: >500 5xx/min from edge in us-west-2. Escalation: primary oncall.

Priya K: I just got a notification but it landed in #devops-labs. I’m not on primary for prod — I’m currently scheduled on infra-ops. Can someone confirm which schedule was active?

Sam H: weird, PD shows the incident targeted `infra-oncall` policy, but the notification went to devops-labs slack integration. Suspect routing key mismatch after the rotation swap last night.

Jared M: @Priya @Sam please confirm if there are any active customer-facing errors right now. I can take the page if needed.

Priya K: checking logs now — edge proxies show a surge of 502/504s starting at 2025-03-14T03:11:00Z. Affected customers: a few high-volume tenants in us-west-2. Not all requests fail; ~12% error rate on traffic spike.

Anya S: On PD side I'm seeing an on-call schedule swap executed at 2025-03-14T03:00:05Z by the rotation script (`rotation-service`). It replaced `infra-oncall` with `devops-oncall` in the `redwood-prod-escalation` policy due to a maint window marker. That looked incorrect.

Sam H: confirm command output from PD API: 
```
pd escalation_policy get redwood-prod-escalation --service redwood-inference-prod
// current steps:
// step 1 -> devops-oncall (rotation id: rot-234)
// step 2 -> infra-oncall (rotation id: rot-78)
```

Priya K: that explains why the slack integration targeted devops. Someone toggled maintenance schedule and the rotation map logic inverted.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-45892 acknowledged by Priya K.

Jared M: Thanks for ack. Two immediate asks: (1) route future alerts back to infra-oncall ASAP, (2) mitigate customer impact.

Sam H: Routing fix — I'm going to pause the `redwood-inference-prod` service notifications and manually set escalation back to infra-oncall. Commands: 
```
pd service update redwood-inference-prod --escalation-policy=redwood-prod-escalation
pd escalation_policy update-step redwood-prod-escalation 1 --rotation-id rot-78
pd maintenance_window remove --service redwood-inference-prod --id mw-999
```

Priya K: I'll keep monitoring after reroute. For mitigation: increasing replica count on proxy pool in us-west-2 and rolling restart of the edge gateway nodes to clear potential connection-state issues.

Anya S: FYI, the rotation script used last night's cron job that applied a JSON payload with malformed `priority` field which caused step reordering. I already created a rollback in the rotation service: `rotation-service rollback rot-234`.

support-ops: We're seeing incoming customer tickets titled "intermittent service errors" — raising visibility. No PII exposed.

Jared M: Good. Priya, apply mitigation and post a short blameless summary here when you see error rates fall below 1%. If they don't, we'll declare a full-sev2 and expand the bridge.

Priya K: Mitigation applied: scaled proxies + restart initiated. Early signs: error rate down to 4% after scaling, will watch.

pagerduty-bot: Notification routing updated: `redwood-prod-escalation` step 1 -> infra-oncall.

Sam H: Can someone run a quick PD audit to find who scheduled the maintenance/rotation change? Need root cause about how a maint marker triggered a rotation swap.

Anya S: I pulled the audit: `rotation-service` executed job id job-8742 created by `ops-automation` user (service account). The job contained an accidental `overwrite=true` flag. Opening ticket: OPS-1234.

Jared M: Action items: 
- Anya: ticket OPS-1234 for rotation-service patch, remove overwrite flag and add validation.
- Sam: postmortem checklist and PD rule hardening to prevent schedule reordering during maintenance.
- Priya: follow up on customer comms draft, notify affected tenants.
- Support-ops: compile ticket list for impacted customers.

Priya K: Taking handoff — @Jared I will stay on until errors <1% for 30m then hand to oncall. Targeting full recovery window at 03:55Z.

support-ops: Noted, sending proactive messages to 3 affected tenants now.

Anya S: Patch deployed to rotation-service to reject overwrite in manual jobs — monitoring.

Priya K: Errors at 0.8% — holding for 30m. Will create follow-up incident note with timeline and include the PD audit and `rotation-service` logs.

Jared M: Thanks team. We'll convert to a follow-up postmortem. Marking this thread as the live-mitigation channel for INC-45892. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: incident INC-45892 transitioned to "monitoring".

Priya K: FINAL: handoff to infra-oncall at 04:30Z. Root cause hypothesis: automated rotation job with bad payload triggered wrong escalation during a maintenance marker. Customer impact: transient 502/504 spike for a subset of tenants; no data loss. Next steps: postmortem, PD rule guardrails, rotation-service input validation.
